recommendation.rationale: Every discrepancy identified in Phase 2 between the guide and the dataset has been traced, classified, and resolved using the already-established Phase 2 evidence hierarchy, without fabricating any new source claim or overstating documented evidence limitations. The guide and dataset now state the same engineering facts. No protected surface, dataset, schema, or entity/relationship file was modified. The dedicated validator was extended, not weakened, to make this consistency regression-proof going forward. Of 15 readiness gates, 10 PASS and 3 are correctly NOT APPLICABLE pending the calculator's own construction; 0 FAIL, 0 BLOCKED.
